name: Elite: squaretable
summary: The table of squares and the back buffer.

labels.name: SquaresLow
labels.comment: n² AND $FF for n = 0-255 (Square, Multiply8, VectorLength, SquareRoot)

labels.name: BackBuffer
labels.comment: The 3D view's back buffer ($C000-$CFFF, the layout of $4000-$4FFF): ClearView clears it, the lines and the circles draw into it, CopyBackBuffer copies it to the screen; docked, its last bytes are the screens' stack (CallScreen sets SP to $D000)
